answer: Resist Sybils with a terrace of first-time domains: every rank climb requires one verified contribution in a field the identity has never touched before, judged by that field's established experts, like a jade carver proving skill in glass. A gale of fresh work keeps sweeping each terrace clean of copied claims, since a past deed in one domain buys no standing in the next. A farmer's hundred clones must each master a new domain per rank, paying genuine learning costs again and again, while honest agents diversify naturally and their breadth becomes their shield.
